title: The rate limit
prompt: How many requests per minute may one API key make, and what happens to a request over the limit?

expect.answer: 600 requests per minute; a request over the limit gets status 429 with a Retry-After header.

title: An unused key
prompt: What happens to an API key nobody has used for a long time?

expect.answer: A key unused for 90 days is disabled and must be re-enabled in the console. Keys do not expire otherwise.

title: Moving a project
prompt: How do I move a project to another region?

expect.answer: A project is tied to its region; to move it, export the project and import it in the new region.

title: Batches and the limit
prompt: If I send one batch request with 40 items, how much of my rate limit does it use?

expect.answer: 40 requests: a batch counts as one request per item.

title: An unpaid invoice
prompt: What stops working if we do not pay an invoice, and when?

expect.answer: Write access is suspended after 14 days; reads keep working.
